messages.author: c4b09b129d99cc26
messages.subject: Set initial values for 2 chains
parts:
Hi everyone,

I've run a bym2 model with one chain without error. However, when I tried setting initial values for two chains as
inits <- list(
  list(alpha=0, tau.b=1,tau.alpha=1,rho=0.5,u=rep(0,N),v=rep(0,N)),
  list(alpha=0.5, tau.b=0.5,tau.alpha=0.5,rho=0.8,u=rep(0,N),v=rep(0,N)))
and create nimble model as
MR <- nimbleModel(
  code = model_code,
  name = "MR",
  constants = nb.const,
  data = nb.data,
  inits = inits)
I've got this error
Error in if (initName %in% names(dL)) { : argument is of length zero

I'm nor sure why there is such an error? I can provide a reproducible example if necessary.
Thank you.

Best regards,
Hanah

messages.author: c9e9cbbfb3b043f0
messages.subject: Re: Set initial values for 2 chains
parts:
The nimbleModel function creates a model object, and only accepts a single set of initial values (a list of named values), which will be used to initialize the model object.

The runMCMC (and nimbleMCMC) functions will accept a list of lists of initial values (as you tried to do), and will use them to initialize the model at the onset of each MCMC chain.

Let me know if that doesn't make sense.
